msdynmkt_email.msdynmkt_designerhtml:
Hello {{FirstName}},


Thank you for registering your interest in The Level the Field Learning and Development Hub.


We're pleased to announce that The Hub is now live and ready for organisations and staff across the sport and active recreation sector to join.


The Level the Field Learning and Development Hub has been developed to help organisations create more inclusive workplaces and build meaningful pathways for people with disability to participate, contribute and lead within the sector.


Organisation Sign up process

To ensure your organisation can access The Hub, one authorised representative/nominee must first register the organisation.


Step 1

One authorised representative/nominee completes the organisation registration on behalf of the organisation using the link below:

Sign up your organisation for The Hub

Step 2


Once the organisation sign up is complete, a username and password for the representative, as a new Hub learner will be provided.


Step 3


The representative will also receive an email which contains the Access Redemption Code unique to the organisation it represents, and a link for sign up. This access code and link should be provided to the organisations staff members to connect each learner to Hub access.


Step 4

Staff members can then use this access code and link to create their individual learner accounts and connect to the appropriate organisation within The Hub.


This process helps ensure your organisation's learning community is connected and can access relevant resources and opportunities together.


We look forward to welcoming your organisation to The Level the Field Learning and Development Hub and supporting your inclusion journey.


Kind Regards,


The Level the Field team


Disability Sport & Recreation


 

We guarantee the confidentiality of all membership information. We will not disclose your details to any third-party entity outside of DSR unless you provide your authorisation. Refer to our Privacy Policy for more information.

Hello {{FirstName}},


Thank you for registering your interest in The Level the Field Learning and Development Hub.


We're pleased to announce that The Hub is now live and ready for organisations and staff across the sport and active recreation sector to join.


The Level the Field Learning and Development Hub has been developed to help organisations create more inclusive workplaces and build meaningful pathways for people with disability to participate, contribute and lead within the sector.


Organisation Sign up process

To ensure your organisation can access The Hub, one authorised representative/nominee must first register the organisation.


Step 1

One authorised representative/nominee completes the organisation registration on behalf of the organisation using the link below:

Sign up your organisation for The Hub

Step 2


Once the organisation sign up is complete, a username and password for the representative, as a new Hub learner will be provided.


Step 3


The representative will also receive an email which contains the Access Redemption Code unique to the organisation it represents, and a link for sign up. This access code and link should be provided to the organisations staff members to connect each learner to Hub access.


Step 4

Staff members can then use this access code and link to create their individual learner accounts and connect to the appropriate organisation within The Hub.


This process helps ensure your organisation's learning community is connected and can access relevant resources and opportunities together.


We look forward to welcoming your organisation to The Level the Field Learning and Development Hub and supporting your inclusion journey.


Kind Regards,


The Level the Field team


Disability Sport & Recreation


 

We guarantee the confidentiality of all membership information. We will not disclose your details to any third-party entity outside of DSR unless you provide your authorisation. Refer to our Privacy Policy for more information.

msdynmkt_email.msdynmkt_designerhtml:
A message from our CEO


As we approach the end of another incredible year at Disability Sport & Recreation (DSR), we are excited to reflect on our achievements over the past year.


We proudly introduced initiatives that demonstrate our commitment to enhancing the lives of people with disability. The DSR CEO Wheelchair Challenge, launched in October at the MCG, brought leaders together to experience the challenges faced by wheelchair users. The funds raised will help create greater access to sport and recreation for people with disabilities.


We also celebrated the success of the Smith-Magenis Syndrome Camp at Camp Manyung on the Mornington Peninsula. This heartwarming weekend of connection and fun-filled activities marked a successful first trial of this important initiative.


Through our education programs, wheelchair rugby initiatives and community events, we continue to build our legacy and drive positive change. For more details on our accomplishments, we invite you to read our 2023-24 Annual Report.


While we were disappointed to cancel the 2024 DSR Festival due to unforeseen circumstances, we are committed to returning bigger and better next year.


Looking ahead, we are thrilled to share that DSR has been appointed as the lead organisation to implement a Learning and Development Hub as part of the Victorian Government’s All-Abilities Workforce and Sector Support Program. Over the next three years, we will design, develop and deliver resources and training to enhance disability inclusion in the sport and active recreation sector.


A heartfelt thank you to our members, supporters, partners, sponsors, volunteers, staff and Board Directors. Your dedication and continued support in helping us build a more inclusive future through sport and recreation.


Wishing you a joyful and festive holiday season!


Liz Tesone, CEO

 

Our Highlights

 

2023-24 Annual Report

We are delighted to share our Disability Sport & Recreation 2023-24 Annual Report, a period filled with remarkable achievements, growth and exciting developments.

The Power of Your Support  

This year, we share the inspiring story of our friend Jacob. Join us in supporting Jacob and countless others by breaking down barriers and expanding access to sport and recreation for people with disabilities.
Read more
Donate Today!

A Heartwarming Weekend

In November, we partnered with SMS Australia to host an unforgettable Smith-Magenis Syndrome (SMS) camp at Camp Manyung on the Mornington Peninsula, bringing together families, children, and supporters for a truly memorable experience.

2024 Wheelchair Rugby Victoria Recap

This year we continued our Junior Development Program, saw fierce competition in the Protect Victorian Wheelchair Rugby Cup and celebrated standout performances nationally and internationally.
Read more
Read more

2024 Victorian DSR Awards

On Thursday 3rd October, over 160 guests gathered at EY in Melbourne’s CBD to celebrate the achievements across our disability sport and recreation sector. The ceremony featured 11 award categories, including the prestigious Kevin Coombs Lifetime Achievement Award, presented to Elle Steele.

DSR CEO Wheelchair Challenge Launch

The iconic Melbourne Cricket Ground (MCG) set the stage for the launch of the DSR CEO Wheelchair Challenge on October 25. This flagship event united business leaders, advocates, and athletes to champion inclusion and accessibility through sport.
Read more
Read more

 

Our Community

VICSWIM Inclusion Participation Project  

VICSWIM is offering 100 free enrolments this January for children with a disability to learn swimming and water safety skills. Spots are limited!

Discover Accessible Walks Across Victoria!

Explore breathtaking landscapes and embrace adventure with over 40+ accessible tracks across Victoria to explore over your summer break.
Find out more
Find out more

A heartfelt thank you to our members, supporters, partners, sponsors, volunteers, staff and Board Directors. Your dedication and continued support in helping us build a more inclusive future through sport and recreation.


Wishing you a joyful and festive holiday season!


Liz Tesone, CEO

 

Our Highlights

 

2023-24 Annual Report

We are delighted to share our Disability Sport & Recreation 2023-24 Annual Report, a period filled with remarkable achievements, growth and exciting developments.

The Power of Your Support  

This year, we share the inspiring story of our friend Jacob. Join us in supporting Jacob and countless others by breaking down barriers and expanding access to sport and recreation for people with disabilities.

Donate Today!

A Heartwarming Weekend

In November, we partnered with SMS Australia to host an unforgettable Smith-Magenis Syndrome (SMS) camp at Camp Manyung on the Mornington Peninsula, bringing together families, children, and supporters for a truly memorable experience.

2024 Wheelchair Rugby Victoria Recap

This year we continued our Junior Development Program, saw fierce competition in the Protect Victorian Wheelchair Rugby Cup and celebrated standout performances nationally and internationally.
Read more
Read more

2024 Victorian DSR Awards

On Thursday 3rd October, over 160 guests gathered at EY in Melbourne’s CBD to celebrate the achievements across our disability sport and recreation sector. The ceremony featured 11 award categories, including the prestigious Kevin Coombs Lifetime Achievement Award, presented to Elle Steele.

DSR CEO Wheelchair Challenge Launch

The iconic Melbourne Cricket Ground (MCG) set the stage for the launch of the DSR CEO Wheelchair Challenge on October 25. This flagship event united business leaders, advocates, and athletes to champion inclusion and accessibility through sport.

A message from our CEO


As we approach the end of another incredible year at Disability Sport & Recreation (DSR), we are excited to reflect on our achievements over the past year.


We proudly introduced initiatives that demonstrate our commitment to enhancing the lives of people with disability. The DSR CEO Wheelchair Challenge, launched in October at the MCG, brought leaders together to experience the challenges faced by wheelchair users. The funds raised will help create greater access to sport and recreation for people with disabilities.


We also celebrated the success of the Smith-Magenis Syndrome Camp at Camp Manyung on the Mornington Peninsula. This heartwarming weekend of connection and fun-filled activities marked a successful first trial of this important initiative.


Through our education programs, wheelchair rugby initiatives and community events, we continue to build our legacy and drive positive change. For more details on our accomplishments, we invite you to read our 2023-24 Annual Report.


While we were disappointed to cancel the 2024 DSR Festival due to unforeseen circumstances, we are committed to returning bigger and better next year.


Looking ahead, we are thrilled to share that DSR has been appointed as the lead organisation to implement a Learning and Development Hub as part of the Victorian Government’s All-Abilities Workforce and Sector Support Program. Over the next three years, we will design, develop and deliver resources and training to enhance disability inclusion in the sport and active recreation sector.


A heartfelt thank you to our members, supporters, partners, sponsors, volunteers, staff and Board Directors. Your dedication and continued support in helping us build a more inclusive future through sport and recreation.

Thank you so much for your kind donation of ${{TotalAmountRealised1}}​ to Disability Sport & Recreation.


Many of us take playing sport and being active for granted. But for Victorians with disability, it’s a very different story.


Your donation will help change lives by creating opportunities for people with disability to take part in sport and recreation.


Learn more about how your donation will provide support and services to Victorians with disability on our website:​ www.dsr.org.au


All donations over $2 are tax deductible so please hold on to this receipt.


Thank you again for supporting Disability Sport & Recreation. Together, we are helping Victorians with disability get active and live healthier, happier lives.

Dear {{FirstName}},


As one of our valued donors, your generosity has helped young Victorians living with disability find confidence, connection and belonging through sport and recreation. We recognise your loyal and dedicated commitment to our work and offer our most sincere thanks.


This year, your support will help fund vital programs for young Victorians living with and learning about disability. Your contribution helps create inclusive sport pathways, camps and community events that open doors for young people and their families.


Because of people like you, more young people can experience what Amèlie found: joy, independence, purpose and a community that believes in what is possible.


Please take a moment to read Amèlie’s story here:

Any gift you can make today will help us deliver life-changing opportunities for more young Victorians living with disability. You can make a secure donation now.

Donate Now.

With my deepest thanks,

Liz Tesone

CEO, Disability Sport & Recreation

Because of people like you, more young people can experience what Amèlie found: joy, independence, purpose and a community that believes in what is possible.


Please take a moment to read Amèlie’s story here:

Any gift you can make today will help us deliver life-changing opportunities for more young Victorians living with disability. You can make a secure donation now.

Donate Now.

With my deepest thanks,

Liz Tesone

msdynmkt_email.msdynmkt_designerhtml:
Hello {{FirstName}},


Thank you for registering your interest in The Level the Field Learning and Development Hub.


We're excited that you'd like to be part of this journey and will keep you updated with information about The Hub, including launch announcements, new learning opportunities and how to get started.


The Level the Field Learning and Development Hub is being developed to support people with disability to explore and build pathways into the sport and active recreation sector. Whether you're considering your first opportunity or looking to grow your skills and confidence, The Hub will provide practical and accessible learning to support your goals.


Our goal is to create a learning environment that supports people with disability to explore meaningful opportunities and thrive in sport and active recreation workplaces and communities.


Thank you again for your interest. We look forward to sharing more with you soon.


Kind Regards,


The Level the Field team


Disability Sport & Recreation


 

We guarantee the confidentiality of all membership information.  Refer to our Privacy Policy for more information.

Hello {{FirstName}},


Thank you for registering your interest in The Level the Field Learning and Development Hub.


We're excited that you'd like to be part of this journey and will keep you updated with information about The Hub, including launch announcements, new learning opportunities and how to get started.


The Level the Field Learning and Development Hub is being developed to support people with disability to explore and build pathways into the sport and active recreation sector. Whether you're considering your first opportunity or looking to grow your skills and confidence, The Hub will provide practical and accessible learning to support your goals.


Our goal is to create a learning environment that supports people with disability to explore meaningful opportunities and thrive in sport and active recreation workplaces and communities.


Thank you again for your interest. We look forward to sharing more with you soon.


Kind Regards,


The Level the Field team

msdynmkt_email.msdynmkt_designerhtml:
Dear {{FirstName}},


Thank you — and welcome to Disability Sport & Recreation family.


Your generous support is more than a donation. It is a belief in a more active, inclusive Victoria, where people living with disability have the chance to connect, participate and thrive.


Because of you, DSR can continue delivering vital programs such as WheelTalk, DSR Kids Camps, our Festival and Awards — programs that build confidence, create connection and open doors for Victorians living with disability.


For many participants and families, these opportunities are life-changing. They bring joy, independence, friendship and pride — and they remind people they are seen, valued and included.


That is why your support matters. You are helping fund programs that do more than get people active. You are helping change lives, challenge perceptions and strengthen communities across Victoria.

To see the impact your support helps create, you can read Amélie’s story: Meet Amèlie.


Thank you again for standing with DSR. We are so grateful to have you with us.

With my deepest thanks,

Liz Tesone

CEO, Disability Sport & Recreation

 

© Copyright 2026 Disability Sport & Recreation. All rights reserved.

Our email address is:

msdynmkt_email.msdynmkt_designerhtml:
Dear {{FirstName}},


As someone who has previously stood with Disability Sport & Recreation, you know that sport and recreation can change lives. Every day, we work to fund programs that create opportunities for people living with a disability to build confidence, improve wellbeing, develop friendships and experience the joy of being active.


As a not-for-profit organisation, we rely on the generosity of our community to make this possible. Every donation, no matter the size, helps more people access life-changing programs and opportunities.


One of those people is Amélie. Her story is a wonderful reminder of the difference your support can make:

Any donation is generous and will help us fund vital programs that support Victorians living with a disability.  You can make a secure donation now.

Donate Now.

Thank you for being part of our community. We’d love to have you with us again as we continue creating opportunities for people with disability to participate, connect and thrive

With my deepest thanks,

Liz Tesone

CEO, Disability Sport & Recreation

 

© Copyright 2026 Disability Sport & Recreation. All rights reserved.

Our email address is:

Dear {{FirstName}},


As one of our valued donors and supporters, we are delighted to invite you to join us at the Disability Sport & Recreation Festival.


This special event celebrates the incredible para sport and para recreation organisations across Victoria, showcasing the people, partnerships and programs that are creating more inclusive opportunities for people with disability to participate, compete and thrive.


Your generosity helps make this work possible, and we’d love for you to celebrate the impact of your support with us.


To learn more about the Festival, including the program and event details, visit:

DSR Festival


We hope you can join us for this special celebration. 

With my deepest thanks,

Liz Tesone

CEO, Disability Sport & Recreation

{{CompanyAddress}}​

Hello {{FirstName}},


Thank you for registering your interest in The Level the Field Learning and Development Hub.


We're pleased to have you join our growing community and will keep you informed as The Hub develops, including launch details, new learning content and opportunities for your organisation to engage.


The Level the Field Learning and Development Hub is being designed to support organisations, leaders and employees across the sport and active recreation sector to build more inclusive workplaces and create meaningful opportunities for people with disability.


The Hub will continue to grow over time, providing a range of learning experiences, resources and practical tools to help the sport and active recreation sector create lasting change.

Dear {{FirstName}},


It’s been a little while since we last connected, but we wanted to share a story we think you’ll love.


When Amélie discovered Disability Sport & Recreation, she found more than a place to be active—she found confidence, connection and the chance to thrive. Today, she’s enjoying opportunities that once felt out of reach


You can read Amélie’s inspiring story here: Meet Amèlie.


Supporters like you help make stories like hers possible. Your past generosity has opened doors for people living with disability to experience the joy of sport, build friendships and discover what’s possible.

Any donation is generous and helps us fund vital programs that will help more people like Amélie find their confidence, community and sense of belonging.

Donate Now.

Thank you for being part of our community. We’d love to welcome you back and continue creating life-changing opportunities together.

With my deepest thanks,

Liz Tesone

CEO, Disability Sport & Recreation

 

© Copyright 2026 Disability Sport & Recreation. All rights reserved.

Our email address is:

Hello {{FirstName}},


Thank you for registering your interest in The Level the Field Learning and Development Hub.


We're excited to let you know that The Hub is now live and ready for you to explore.


The Level the Field Learning and Development Hub has been designed to support people with disability, carers and support people to explore opportunities within the sport and active recreation sector, build confidence and develop skills that can support employment, volunteering and leadership pathways.


Sign up today!


To create your account and start exploring the learning available in The Hub, click the link below:

Sign up for The Hub

Once you sign up for access, keep a look out for an email that will confirm your username and password.


We look forward to welcoming you to The Level the Field Learning and Development Hub and supporting your journey in sport and active recreation.

Kind Regards,


The Level the Field team


Disability Sport & Recreation


 

We guarantee the confidentiality of all membership information. We will not disclose your details to any third-party entity outside of DSR unless you provide your authorisation. Refer to our Privacy Policy for more information.

 

© Copyright 2026 Disability Sport & Recreation. All rights reserved.

Our email address is:

Empower Students to Embrace Difference
WheelTalk bookings now open for Term 2 & 3

WheelTalk is an engaging and interactive incursion that aims to inspire diversity, acceptance, and empathy among students through:


🌟 Engaging Presenters: Victorians with a disability who are actively involved in sport and recreation share their unique stories.

🏀 Interactive Experiences: Students get hands-on with activities and can play wheelchair basketball or wheelchair rugby!

🤝 Students gain new perspectives by stepping into the shoes of others, cultivating inclusive mindsets.

BOOK HERE!

See our program in action in our recent feature on ABC News.

For more information on this program, please visit our website at www.dsr.org.au/wheeltalk or call us at (03) 8652 9722.

 

© Copyright 2026 Disability Sport & Recreation. All rights reserved.

msdynmkt_email.msdynmkt_designerhtml:
Dear {{FirstName}},


Thank you so much for joining the Disability Sport & Recreation Regular Giving Family.


Your monthly gift may seem like a small act, but together with the generosity of others like you, it helps create life-changing opportunities for Victorians with disability to discover the joy, confidence and connection that sport and recreation can bring.


I often think of young people like Amélie. When she was diagnosed with a rare genetic condition, her family were told all the things she might never do. But through inclusive sport, Amélie found confidence, friendship and a place where she truly belonged.   You can find her story at

We will keep you updated with our quarterly DSR News newsletter, so you can see the difference your generosity is making throughout the year.


If you ever have any questions, or if you’d like to change or pause your monthly gift, please don’t hesitate to contact us directly on 8652 9722.


Thank you again for believing in our vision. We are truly honoured to have you with us, and I can’t wait to share the impact you’ll help make possible.

With my deepest thanks,

Liz Tesone

CEO, Disability Sport & Recreation

 

© Copyright 2026 Disability Sport & Recreation. All rights reserved.

Our email address is:

{{CompanyAddress}}​

You can update your preference or unsubscribe

Dear {{FirstName}},


Thank you so much for joining the Disability Sport & Recreation Regular Giving Family.


Your monthly gift may seem like a small act, but together with the generosity of others like you, it helps create life-changing opportunities for Victorians with disability to discover the joy, confidence and connection that sport and recreation can bring.


I often think of young people like Amélie. When she was diagnosed with a rare genetic condition, her family were told all the things she might never do. But through inclusive sport, Amélie found confidence, friendship and a place where she truly belonged.   You can find her story at

We will keep you updated with our quarterly DSR News newsletter, so you can see the difference your generosity is making throughout the year.


If you ever have any questions, or if you’d like to change or pause your monthly gift, please don’t hesitate to contact us directly on 8652 9722.


Thank you again for believing in our vision. We are truly honoured to have you with us, and I can’t wait to share the impact you’ll help make possible.

With my deepest thanks,

Liz Tesone

CEO, Disability Sport & Recreation

msdynmkt_email.msdynmkt_designerhtml:
Dear {{FirstName}},


I hope this e mail finds you well.


We extend a most sincere thanks to you for your loyal and dedicated support of our work. We acknowledge your contributions; they have assisted us greatly in delivering programs to young Victorians living with disability. We do not take your support for granted and are always very grateful for your involvement with our work and are hopeful that you may consider supporting our current campaign.


We are contacting all our members, supporters, and sponsors in 2026 with funding required for 6 major programs and events:


  • DSR Kids Camps - For Children with disabilities held at Camp Manyung on the Mornington Peninsula.
  • DSR Hospital Program – For children aged 7-17 years of age with acquired disability.
  • DSR Wheel-talk – Schools Program reaching more than 250 metropolitan and regional schools across Victoria and expanding quickly.
  • DSR Awards – At Marvel Stadium, a celebration of Disability Sport for Victorians who have achieved outstanding success.
  • DSR Festival – The Crown Promenade in December, a celebration of Disability Sport in Victoria.

We are very relaint on community support to help fund these important programs and events. Any contribution is generous, and we submit this request for consideration and invite your support.

Please support more people like Amélie, by helping us fund vital programs that support Victorians living with a disability.

Donate Now.


Thank you for taking the time to learn about our work. Together, we can help ensure more people with disability have the opportunity to participate, belong, and thrive through sport.


To learn more about our work, please visit: www.dsr.org.au

With my deepest thanks,

Liz Tesone

CEO, Disability Sport & Recreation

msdynmkt_email.msdynmkt_designerhtml:
Dear {{FirstName}},


I hope you’re doing well.


I’d like to introduce you to Disability Sport & Recreation (DSR), a not-for-profit organisation that has been helping people with disability experience the life-changing benefits of sport and active recreation for over 60 years.


At DSR, we believe everyone deserves the opportunity to participate, connect, build confidence, and thrive through sport—regardless of ability. Every day, we work with individuals, families, schools, clubs, and communities to remove barriers and create inclusive opportunities that change lives.


One story that beautifully captures this impact is Amélie’s. Through DSR’s support, she discovered a passion for sport, built her confidence, formed lasting friendships, and embraced opportunities that once seemed out of reach. Her journey is a powerful reminder that access to sport can transform lives and create a sense of belonging.

To learn more about our work, please visit:

www.dsr.org.au


Please support more people like Amélie, by helping us fund vital programs that support Victorians living with a disability.

Donate Now.

Thank you for taking the time to learn about our work. Together, we can help ensure more people with disability have the opportunity to participate, belong, and thrive through sport.

With my deepest thanks,

Liz Tesone

CEO, Disability Sport & Recreation

{{CompanyAddress}}​

Every day, we work with individuals, families, schools, clubs, and communities to remove barriers and create inclusive opportunities that change lives. One story that beautifully captures this impact is Amélie’s. Through DSR’s support, she discovered a passion for sport, built her confidence, formed lasting friendships, and embraced opportunities that once seemed out of reach. Her journey is a powerful reminder that access to sport can transform lives and create a sense of belonging. [<https://www.dsr.org.au/post/meet-am%C3%A8lie#_msdynmkt_donottrack=0,_msdynmkt_fn=_unnamedlink-1,_msdynmkt_linkid=20b66984-727c-4d5a-845a-d77b03fc84ab>] To learn more about our work, please visit: [www.dsr.org.au <https://www.dsr.org.au#_msdynmkt_donottrack=0,_msdynmkt_fn=DSR,_msdynmkt_linkid=1b2b0788-5c87-4b15-a10d-0b589facd5c3>] Please support more people like Amélie, by helping us fund vital programs that support Victorians living with a disability. [Donate Now. <https://dsr-site.powerappsportals.com/donate/?page=donate-now#_msdynmkt_donottrack=0,_msdynmkt_fn=donate-now,_msdynmkt_linkid=04eb5b1f-0de5-430b-9db7-3145a8111b5b>] Thank you for taking the time to learn about our work. Together, we can help ensure more people with disability have the opportunity to participate, belong, and thrive through sport. With my deepest thanks, Liz Tesone CEO, Disability Sport & Recreation [<https://www.facebook.com/DisabilitySportAndRecreation#_msdynmkt_donottrack=0,_msdynmkt_fn=_unnamedlink-4,_msdynmkt_linkid=b84aeb14-9756-465d-b115-3aa5423fd3ce>] [<https://www.instagram.com/disabilitysportandrec/#_msdynmkt_donottrack=0,_msdynmkt_fn=_unnamedlink-5,_msdynmkt_linkid=7bb4ee61-8dbb-469c-b2fc-be095b775488>] [<https://www.youtube.com/user/disabilitysportrec#_msdynmkt_donottrack=0,_msdynmkt_fn=_unnamedlink-6,_msdynmkt_linkid=feafc94b-6131-4d75-b9e4-98501cfd996b>] [<https://www.linkedin.com/company/disability-sport-and-recreation/#_msdynmkt_donottrack=0,_msdynmkt_fn=_unnamedlink-7,_msdynmkt_linkid=d8e97834-4022-44a6-8b29-88f8bce11d3a>] © Copyright 2026 Disability Sport & Recreation.
